prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use warm family documentary photography: observe a believable spontaneous moment, unforced expressions, and gentle natural imperfections. A 42-year-old woman with short brown hair pauses on a sofa in her lived-in apartment, a closed book resting in her lap, and gazes thoughtfully toward a window. She appears calm rather than sad. Use soft afternoon daylight, muted linen cushions, warm wood, and an environmental view from across the room. Output a wide horizontal 16:9 composition for a website section. Keep every main person and key interaction centred closely enough to remain fully inside both a central 4:3 crop and a central 1.65:1 crop; scenery may extend to the outer edges. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearance: short dark-brown softly waved hair, small oval reading glasses, hazel eyes, a broad oval face and a comfortably curvy build. Preserve her calm thoughtful gaze toward the window.
Composition priority: exact wide 16:9 aspect ratio. Step the camera back to an environmental medium-wide view. ALL main people, faces, arms, hands and key props must fit entirely in the central 55 percent of image width, leaving substantial believable room or scenery at BOTH sides.
review: Reviewed full image: short brown-haired woman with small glasses sits on a sofa with a closed book and relaxed overlapping hands. Calm face, believable visible fingers and crossed legs; subject remains central with a room and window at both sides. Horizontal 1672x941 matches 16:9 within one pixel.
